correctness.rationale: By polar duality the facets of the real Lipschitz-free unit ball equal vertices of L_n={f(1)=0, |f(i)-f(j)|<=1 when |i-j|<=2}. At a dual vertex active tight edges must connect all n labels (active rank n-1), and a tight spanning tree enforces integer heights. Scanning from left to right, no tight connected component may be abandoned beyond the last two vertices. The six states (increment in {-1,0,1}, last-two joined flag c in {0,1}) completely encode future feasibility; the displayed 6x6 transition T and initial v, terminal w imply F_n=vT^(n-2)w. Exact row identity vT³=vT²+2vT+2v gives recurrence n>=5 and the GF. Independent brute force 2<=n<=11 tested all valid three-valued height increments and directly checked tight-graph connectivity: F=(2,6,12,28,64,144,328,744,1688,3832), matching recursion. Completeness is from boundary-component argument, not finite search.
